# TPC-Havoc Q1_v6

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT l_returnflag, l_linestatus, SUM(l_quantity) FILTER(WHERE l_shipdate <= CAST('1998-12-01' AS DATE) - INTERVAL '90 DAY') AS sum_qty, SUM(l_extendedprice) FILTER(WHERE l_shipdate <= CAST('1998-12-01' AS DATE) - INTERVAL '90 DAY') AS sum_base_price, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) FILTER(WHERE l_shipdate <= CAST('1998-12-01' AS DATE) - INTERVAL '90 DAY') AS sum_disc_price, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) * (1 + l_tax)) FILTER(WHERE l_shipdate <= CAST('1998-12-01' AS DATE) - INTERVAL '90 DAY') AS sum_charge, AVG(l_quantity) FILTER(WHERE l_shipdate <= CAST('1998-12-01' AS DATE) - INTERVAL '90 DAY') AS avg_qty, AVG(l_extendedprice) FILTER(WHERE l_shipdate <= CAST('1998-12-01' AS DATE) - INTERVAL '90 DAY') AS avg_price, AVG(l_discount) FILTER(WHERE l_shipdate <= CAST('1998-12-01' AS DATE) - INTERVAL '90 DAY') AS avg_disc, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE l_shipdate <= CAST('1998-12-01' AS DATE) - INTERVAL '90 DAY') AS count_order FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus ORDER BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus
```
